messages:
Zoe (People Ops): quick update — leadership approved reclassifying our "Wellness Days" (previously floating holidays) starting next fiscal year. :tada:

Zoe (People Ops): TL;DR: employees can convert up to 2 unused Wellness Days into payout during a 30-day conversion window, OR move them to next year as standard PTO carryover up to the usual cap. We need manager sign-off for payouts.

Anika (People Ops): FAQ link: https://intranet.redwood.company/policies/wellness-days (policy draft). Please read before asking payroll questions.

Priya (Product): are contractors eligible for the payout option?

Zoe (People Ops): short answer: no. Contractors and vendors keep current terms (no payout). Only W-2/full-time employees are eligible. We'll update offer letters going forward.

Sam (Eng, Manager): how will this show up in the manager approval flow? Can I bulk-approve for my team?

Marcus (Payroll): we'll add a manager approval step in the PTO system. No bulk button initially — we want an explicit approval for each payout to capture consent. If demand is high we can add bulk tools in Q2.

Sam (Eng, Manager): got it. rough timeline?

Zoe (People Ops): conversion window opens 2025-01-15 and closes 2025-02-14. Payroll cutoff for payouts is 2025-02-20 (so approvals should be completed by 2025-02-18 to give us time).

Priya (Product): what about part-timers who have prorated Wellness Days? pro-rate math?

Anika (People Ops): part-timers get pro-rated eligibility. Example in the doc. If someone started mid-year, payout amount = (eligible days / 12) * months employed rounded to nearest half-day. We'll attach a calculator to the conversion form.

Oliver (Legal): one note — for employees on approved medical leave during the window, we need to ensure they get the same options. We'll provide an exception flow. @Zoe can you route the special-case list to me before cutoff?

Zoe (People Ops): yes — please send exceptions to people-ops@redwood.company and cc Oliver. We'll do manual handling for LOA/medical cases.

Marcus (Payroll): payroll-bot will post a reminder 7 days before cutoff and again 48 hours before. Expect these automated messages in #people-ops and a report to managers.

payroll-bot: Reminder scheduled: conversion window ends 2025-02-14. Manager approvals due by 2025-02-18.

Priya (Product): will Wellness Days still be separate from PTO for scheduling/time-off requests?

Zoe (People Ops): yes — they'll remain a separate bucket in the time-off UI, labeled "Wellness Day". For payroll conversion we move them to a payout ledger entry. For carryover they merge into PTO per the standard carryover cap.

Sam (Eng, Manager): last q — does this affect holiday blackout windows around year-end?

Anika (People Ops): no change to blackout dates. Wellness Day conversion is independent of blackout policies. If someone needs time off during a blackout they still follow existing approval exceptions.

Zoe (People Ops): action items: 1) Managers: review team balances by 2025-01-20. 2) Employees: fill conversion form during window. Link in the doc. 3) Managers: approve or deny payouts by 2025-02-18.

Sam (Eng, Manager): thanks — will ping my direct reports this afternoon. :+1:

Priya (Product): smart move to keep the separate bucket. thanks for the heads up!

Zoe (People Ops): thanks all — will post the final policy and an explainer video tomorrow. :wave:
